A shocking gangrape case has come to light in Delhi, where a woman was allegedly sexually assaulted after a cafe was reopened following its closing hours. According to reports, three accused have been arrested in connection with the incident, while the remaining suspects are still absconding. The incident has raised serious concerns about women's safety and security in the national capital. How did the accused allegedly carry out the crime? What happened after the cafe was closed, and what action has the police taken so far?
